title: 2023年英语二写作(图表题干待提取)
prompt:
Section IV Writing
Part A
47. Directions:
An art exhibition and a robot show are to be held on Sunday, and your friend David asks
you which one he should go to. Write him an email to
1) make a suggestion, and
2) give your reason(s).
Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name in your email, use “Li Ming” instead. (10 points)

trends: account for the largest proportion of
comparisons: the gap between... and... is striking
reasons: can be attributed to the accelerating pace of life
hinge upon the increasing need for flexibility
stem from a growing awareness of health
